ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is the bulk polymerization and solution polymerization process of methyl methacrylate (MMA). When the MMA solution concentration is lower than 40%, the polymerization reaction does not show an autoacceleration phenomenon; when the concentration is higher than $\boxed{\qquad}$, the autoacceleration phenomenon will appear.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the figure is a “methyl methacrylate polymerization conversion-time curve”; the vertical axis is conversion/%, and the horizontal axis is time/min; the numbers on the curves indicate monomer concentration, and 10%, 40%, 60%, 80%, and 100% can be seen in sequence. The curves for 10% and 40% rise relatively gently with time and have no obvious sudden steepening; the curve for 60% begins to show a relatively obvious increase in slope in the middle-to-late section; the slopes of the curves for 80% and 100% increase more significantly, showing a rapid rise. Reasoning: the autoacceleration phenomenon can be judged by a sudden increase in the slope of the conversion-time curve. The question text has already stated that no autoacceleration is shown below 40%; by comparing the 40% and 60% curves in the figure, 40% is still relatively smooth, whereas 60% begins to show an obvious accelerated rise, so the concentration boundary for the appearance of autoacceleration should be 60%. Therefore fill 60 in the blank.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的转化率-时间曲线及各曲线对应的单体浓度。根据自动加速对应曲线斜率突然增大的判据，比较40%与60%两条曲线：40%仍较平滑，而60%开始出现明显加速上升，80%和100%更显著。因此出现自动加速所需的浓度分界为高于60%，空格填60。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是“甲基丙烯酸甲酯聚合转化率-时间曲线”，纵轴为转化率/%，横轴为时间/min；曲线上的数字表示单体浓度，依次可见10%、40%、60%、80%、100%。10%和40%的曲线随时间上升较平缓，没有明显突然变陡；60%的曲线在中后段开始出现较明显的斜率增大；80%和100%的曲线斜率增大更显著，表现出快速上升。推理：自动加速现象可由转化率-时间曲线斜率突然增大来判断。题干已说明低于40%时未显现自动加速；由图比较40%与60%曲线，40%仍较平滑，而60%开始出现明显加速上升，因此出现自动加速的浓度分界应为60%。所以空格填60。
